description: A blank 3HP panel carrying the Mockba Modular logo, for filling a gap in the rack
notes: The background can also be set outside Rack, by the Background entry in MockbaModular.json in Rack's user folder, which names one of the three background files in the plugin's res folder
menu: Background theme — Light, Dark or Aged; repaints this panel and is saved as the background every Mockba Modular module loads as it is added to the rack
